exposure: hormone replacement therapy (HRT) endometrial preparation protocol
cohort: The study included 1783 women at high risk of ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome who underwent frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) using assisted reproductive technology between January 2021 and December 2022.
finding: For patients at high risk of ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome undergoing frozen-thawed embryo transfer, both the ovarian stimulation (OS) and natural cycle (NC) protocols showed superior pregnancy outcomes, including higher rates of live birth and biochemical pregnancy, compared to the hormone replacement therapy (HRT) protocol.
mod_finding: The natural cycle (NC) group had a lower cesarean delivery rate compared to the hormone replacement therapy (HRT) group.
